verses.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
verses.pt: Ora, o rei Salomão amou muitas mulheres estrangeiras, além da filha de Faraó: moabitas, amonitas, edomitas, sidônias e heteias,
verses.en_web: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites;
verses.en_bbe: Now a number of strange women were loved by Solomon, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:

verses.en: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.pt: das nações de que o Senhor dissera aos filhos de Israel: Não ireis para elas, nem elas virão para vós; doutra maneira perverterão o vosso coração para seguirdes os seus deuses. A estas se apegou Salomão, levado pelo amor.
verses.en_web: of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you; for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.
verses.en_bbe: The nations of which the Lord had said to the children of Israel, You are not to take wives from them and they are not to take wives from you; or they will certainly make you go after their gods: to these Solomon was united in love.

verses.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.pt: Tinha ele setecentas mulheres, princesas, e trezentas concubinas; e suas mulheres lhe perverteram o coração.
verses.en_web: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.en_bbe: He had seven hundred wives, daughters of kings, and three hundred other wives; and through his wives his heart was turned away.

verses.en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.pt: Pois sucedeu que, no tempo da velhice de Salomão, suas mulheres lhe perverteram o coração para seguir outros deuses; e e seu coração já não era perfeito para com o Senhor seu Deus, como fora o de Davi, seu pai;
verses.en_web: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.
verses.en_bbe: For it came about that when Solomon was old, his heart was turned away to other gods by his wives; and his heart was no longer true to the Lord his God as the heart of his father David had been.

verses.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.pt: Salomão seguiu a Astarete, deusa dos sidônios, e a Milcom, abominação dos amonitas.
verses.en_web: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.en_bbe: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Milcom, the disgusting god of the Ammonites.

verses.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.pt: Assim fez Salomão o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, e não perseverou em seguir, como fizera Davi, seu pai.
verses.en_web: Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not walking in the Lord's ways with all his heart as David his father did.

verses.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.pt: Nesse tempo edificou Salomão um alto a Quemós, abominação dos moabitas, sobre e monte que está diante de Jerusalém, e a Moleque, abominação dos amonitas.
verses.en_web: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.en_bbe: Then Solomon put up a high place for Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, in the mountain before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the disgusting god worshipped by the children of Ammon.

verses.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.pt: E assim fez para todas as suas mulheres estrangeiras, as quais queimavam incenso e ofereciam sacrifícios a seus deuses.
verses.en_web: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.en_bbe: And so he did for all his strange wives, who made offerings with burning of perfumes to their gods.

verses.en: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor se indignou contra Salomão, porquanto e seu coração se desviara do Senhor Deus de Israel, o qual duas vezes lhe aparecera,
verses.en_web: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the Lord, the God of Israel, who had twice come to him in a vision;

verses.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
verses.pt: e lhe ordenara expressamente que não seguisse a outros deuses. Ele, porém, não guardou o que o Senhor lhe ordenara.
verses.en_web: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.
verses.en_bbe: And had given him orders about this very thing, that he was not to go after other gods; but he did not keep the orders of the Lord.

verses.en: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.pt: Disse, pois, o Senhor a Salomão: Porquanto houve isto em ti, que não guardaste a meu pacto e os meus estatutos que te ordenei, certamente rasgarei de ti este reino, e o darei a teu servo.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord said to Solomon, Because you have done this, and have not kept my agreement and my laws, which I gave you, I will take the kingdom away from you by force and will give it to your servant.

verses.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.pt: Contudo não o farei nos teus dias, por amor de Davi, teu pai; da mão de teu filho o rasgarei.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
verses.en_bbe: I will not do it in your life-time, because of your father David, but I will take it from your son.

verses.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
verses.pt: Todavia não rasgarei o reino todo; mas uma tribo darei a teu filho, por amor de meu servo Davi, e por amor de Jerusalém, que escolhi.
verses.en_web: However I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”
verses.en_bbe: Still I will not take all the kingdom from him; but I will give one tribe to your son, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town of my selection.

verses.en: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.
verses.pt: O Senhor levantou contra Salomão um adversário, Hadade, o edomeu; o qual era da estirpe real de Edom.
verses.en_web: Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord sent Hadad the Edomite to make trouble for Solomon: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

verses.en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.pt: Porque sucedeu que, quando Davi esteve em guerra contra Edom, tendo Jeabe, o chefe do exército, subido a enterrar os mortos, e ferido a todo varão em Edom
verses.en_web: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom
verses.en_bbe: And when David had sent destruction on Edom, and Joab, the captain of the army, had gone to put the dead into the earth, and had put to death every male in Edom;

verses.en: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.pt: (porque Joabe ficou ali seis meses com todo o Israel, até que destruiu a todo varão em Edom),
verses.en_web: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom);
verses.en_bbe: (For Joab and all Israel were there six months till every male in Edom had been cut off;)

verses.en: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.pt: Hadade, que era ainda menino, fugiu para o Egito com alguns edemeus, servos de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.
verses.en_bbe: Hadad, being still a young boy, went in flight to Egypt, with certain Edomites, servants of his father;

verses.en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.pt: Levantando-se, pois, de Midiã, foram a Parã; e tomando consigo homens de Parã, foram ao Egito ter com Faraó, rei do Egito, o qual deu casa a Hadade, proveu-lhe a subsistência, e lhe deu terras.
verses.en_web: They arose out of Midian, and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.
verses.en_bbe: And they went on from Midian and came to Paran; and, taking men from Paran with them, they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who gave him a house and gave orders for his food and gave him land.

verses.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.pt: E Hadade caiu tanto em graça a Faraó, que este lhe deu por mulher a irmã de sua mulher, a irmã da rainha Tafnes.
verses.en_web: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.en_bbe: Now Hadad was very pleasing to Pharaoh, so that he gave him the sister of his wife, Tahpenes the queen, for his wife.

verses.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.pt: Ora, desta irmã de Tafnes nasceu a Hadade seu filho Genubate, a qual Tafnes criou na casa de Faraó, onde Genubate esteve entre os filhos de rei.
verses.en_web: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: And the sister of Tahpenes had a son by him, Genubath, whom Tahpenes took care of in Pharaoh's house; and Genubath was living in Pharaoh's house among Pharaoh's sons.

verses.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.pt: Ouvindo, pois, Hadade no Egito que Davi adormecera com seus pais, e que Jeabe, chefe do exército, era morto, disse o Faraó: Deixa-me ir, para que eu volte à minha terra.
verses.en_web: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”
verses.en_bbe: Now when Hadad had news in Egypt that David had been put to rest with his fathers, and that Joab, the captain of the army, was dead, he said to Pharaoh, Send me back to my country.

verses.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Faraó: Que te falta em minha companhia, que procuras partir para a tua terra? Respondeu ele: Nada; todavia, peço que me deixes ir.
verses.en_web: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”
verses.en_bbe: But Pharaoh said to him, What have you been short of while you have been with me, that you are desiring to go back to your country? And he said, Nothing; but even so, send me back.

verses.en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.pt: Deus levantou contra Salomão ainda outro adversário, Rezom, filho de Eliadá, que tinha fugido de seu senhor Hadadézer, rei de Zobá.
verses.en_web: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.en_bbe: And God sent another trouble-maker, Rezon, the son of Eliada, who had gone in flight from his lord, Hadadezer, king of Zobah:

verses.en: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.pt: Pois ele ajuntara a si homens, e se fizera capitão de uma tropa, quando Davi matou os de Zebá; e, indo-se para Damasco, habitaram ali; e fizeram-no rei em Damasco.
verses.en_web: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus, and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.en_bbe: He got some men together and made himself captain of a band of outlaws; and went to Damascus and became king there.

verses.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.pt: E foi adversário de Israel por todos os dias de Salomão, e isto além do mal que Hadade fazia; detestava a Israel, e reinava sobre a Síria.
verses.en_web: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, besides the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.en_bbe: He was a trouble to Israel all through the days of Solomon. And this is the damage Hadad did: he was cruel to Israel while he was ruler over Edom.

verses.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.pt: Também Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, efrateu de Zeredá, servo de Salomão, cuja mãe era viúva, por nome Zeruá, levantou a mão contra o rei.
verses.en_web: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.en_bbe: And there was Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother was Zeruah, a widow; and his hand was lifted up against the king.

verses.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.pt: E esta foi a causa por que levantou a mão contra o rei: Salomão tinha edificado a Milo, e cerrado a brecha da cidade de Davi, seu pai.
verses.en_web: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
verses.en_bbe: The way in which his hand came to be lifted up against the king was this: Solomon was building the Millo and making good the damaged parts of the town of his father David;

verses.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.pt: Ora, Jeroboão era homem forte e valente; e vendo Salomão que este mancebo era laborioso, colocou-o sobre toda a carga imposta à casa de José.
verses.en_web: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: And Jeroboam was an able and responsible man; and Solomon saw that he was a good worker and made him overseer of all the work given to the sons of Joseph.

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.pt: E sucedeu naquele tempo que, saindo Jeroboão de Jerusalém, o profeta Aías, o silonita, o encontrou no caminho; este se tinha vestido duma capa nova; e os dois estavam sós no campo.
verses.en_web: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way; now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field.
verses.en_bbe: Now at that time, when Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite came across him on the road; now Ahijah had put on a new robe; and the two of them were by themselves in the open country.

verses.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.pt: Então Aías pegou na capa nova que tinha sobre si, e a rasgou em doze pedaços.
verses.en_web: Ahijah laid hold of the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahijah took his new robe in his hands, parting it violently into twelve.

verses.en: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.pt: E disse a Jeroboão: Toma estes dez pedaços para ti, porque assim diz e Senhor Deus de Israel: Eis que rasgarei o reino da mão de Salomão, e a ti darei dez tribos.
verses.en_web: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to you
verses.en_bbe: And he said to Jeroboam, Take ten of the parts, for this is what the Lord has said: See, I will take the kingdom away from Solomon by force, and will give ten tribes to you;

verses.en: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.pt: Ele, porém, terá uma tribo, por amor de Davi, meu servo, e por amor de Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel);
verses.en_bbe: (But one tribe will be his, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town which, out of all the tribes of Israel, I have made mine,)

verses.en: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.pt: Porque me deixaram, e se encurvaram a Astarote, deusa dos sidônios, a Quemés, deus dos moabitas, e a Milcom, deus dos amonitas; e não andaram pelos meus caminhos, para fazerem o que parece reto aos meus olhos, e para guardarem os meus estatutos e os meus preceitos, como o fez Davi, seu pai.
verses.en_web: because that they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.
verses.en_bbe: Because they are turned away from me to the worship of Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Chemosh, the god of Moab, and Milcom, the god of the Ammonites; they have not been walking in my ways or doing what is right in my eyes or keeping my laws and my decisions as his father David did.

verses.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.pt: Todavia não tomarei da sua mão o reino todo; mas deixá-lo-ei governar por todos os dias da sua vida, por amor de Davi, meu servo, a quem escolhi, o qual guardou os meus mandamentos e os meus estatutos.
verses.en_web: “‘However I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand; but I will make him prince all the days of his life, for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes;
verses.en_bbe: But I will not take the kingdom from him; I will let him be king all the days of his life, because of David my servant, in whom I took delight because he kept my orders and my laws.

verses.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.pt: Mas da mão de seu filho tomarei e reino e to darei a ti, isto é, as dez tribos.
verses.en_web: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it to you, even ten tribes.
verses.en_bbe: But I will take the kingdom from his son, and give it to you.

verses.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.pt: Todavia a seu filho darei uma tribo, para que Davi, meu servo, sempre tenha uma lâmpada diante de mim em Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi para ali pôr o meu nome.
verses.en_web: To his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.
verses.en_bbe: And one tribe I will give to his son, so that David my servant may have a light for ever burning before me in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine to put my name there.

verses.en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.pt: Então te tomarei, e reinarás sobre tudo o que desejar a tua alma, e serás rei sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And you I will take, and you will be king over Israel, ruling over whatever is the desire of your soul.

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.pt: E há de ser que, se ouvires tudo o que eu te ordenar, e andares polos meus caminhos, e fizeres o que é reto aos meus olhos, guardando os meus estatutos e os meus mandamentos, como o fez Davi, meu servo, eu serei contigo, e te edificarei uma casa firme, como o fiz para Davi, e te darei Israel.
verses.en_web: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
verses.en_bbe: And if you give attention to the orders I give you, walking in my ways and doing what is right in my eyes and keeping my laws and my orders as David my servant did; then I will be with you, building up for you a safe house, as I did for David, and I will give Israel to you.

verses.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.pt: E por isso afligirei a descendência de Davi, todavia não para sempre.
verses.en_web: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”
verses.en_bbe: (So that I may send trouble for this on the seed of David, but not for ever.)

verses.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.pt: Pelo que Salomão procurou matar Jeroboão; porém este se levantou, e fugiu para o Egito, a ter com Sisaque, rei de Egito, onde esteve até a morte de Salomão.
verses.en_web: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam; but Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon was looking for a chance to put Jeroboam to death; but he went in flight to Egypt, to Shishak, king of Egypt, and was in Egypt till the death of Solomon.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.pt: Quanto ao restante dos atos de Salomão, e a tudo o que ele fez, e à sua sabedoria, porventura não está escrito no livro dos atos de Salomão?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all he did, and his wisdom, are they not recorded in the book of the acts of Solomon?

verses.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.pt: O tempo que Salomão reinou em Jerusalém sobre todo o Israel foi quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.en_bbe: And the time Solomon was king in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

verses.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E Salomão dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi, seu pai; e Roboão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Solomon went to rest with his fathers and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.
